name: com.shurikenbridge.core
displayName: ShurikenBridge — Zero-CPU GPU Particle System Bridge (URP & Built-in RP)
description: Drop-in GPU Compute + RenderMeshIndirect bridge for Unity's built-in ParticleSystem (Shuriken) on URP 14–17 and Built-in RP. Keep 100% of Unity's native ParticleSystem Inspector UI, Scene gizmos, and any URP/Built-in/Custom/ShaderGraph materials while batching thousands of emitters on the GPU with zero URP source modifications.

samples.description: Standalone 3-Phase A/B benchmark comparing 2,048 built-in CPU Shuriken emitters (131,072 particles across 4 materials) against ShurikenBridge with GPU Frustum Culling, 3-Tier Distance LOD, Plane Bounce Collision, and Force Fields.
